  <p class="lede">How long our Seaglider (firmware 66.12, single 310 Ah lithium pack) will last

  glider's own energy logs: <span id="n_dives">1,500+</span> dives from 2018 to 2022, every
  device's on-time and current. Endurance is from a full pack, less the reserve you keep.</p>

        <div>Usable <b id="o_usable">–</b> Ah</div>

    <div class="alerts" id="alerts"></div>

  <div class="panels">
    <section class="panel">
      <h3>Dive</h3>
      <div class="f"><label for="i_depth">Dive depth</label><div class="ctl"><input type="number" id="i_depth" min="10" max="1000" step="10"><span class="unit">m</span></div></div>
      <div class="f"><label for="i_w">Mean vertical speed</label><div class="ctl"><input type="number" id="i_w" min="0.02" max="0.3" step="0.005"><span class="unit">m/s</span></div>
        <span class="hint" id="h_w">Including apogee.</span></div>
      <div class="f"><label for="i_surface">Time at surface</label><div class="ctl"><input type="number" id="i_surface" min="0" step="1"><span class="unit">min</span></div></div>
      <div class="f"><label for="i_maxbuoy">$MAX_BUOY</label><div class="ctl"><input type="number" id="i_maxbuoy" min="0" step="10"><span class="unit">cc</span></div></div>
      <div class="f"><label for="i_smcc">$SM_CC</label><div class="ctl"><input type="number" id="i_smcc" min="0" step="10"><span class="unit">cc</span></div></div>
      <div class="f"><label for="i_kb">Data sent per call</label><div class="ctl"><input type="number" id="i_kb" min="0" step="10"><span class="unit">kB</span></div>
        <span class="hint">Dive data plus capture file.</span></div>
      <div class="f"><label for="i_calln">$CALL_NDIVES</label><div class="ctl"><input type="number" id="i_calln" min="1" max="10" step="1"></div></div>
    </section>

    <section class="panel">
      <h3>Battery and flight</h3>
      <div class="f"><label for="i_cap">Pack capacity</label><div class="ctl"><input type="number" id="i_cap" min="1" step="5"><span class="unit">Ah</span></div></div>
      <div class="f"><label for="i_reserve">Keep in reserve</label><div class="ctl"><input type="number" id="i_reserve" min="0" max="90" step="1"><span class="unit">%</span></div></div>
      <div class="f"><label for="i_volts">Pack voltage</label><div class="ctl"><input type="number" id="i_volts" min="5" step="0.1"><span class="unit">V</span></div>
        <span class="hint">Converts the pump's energy into Ah. The pack has run between 12.4 and 13.9 V.</span></div>
      <div class="f"><label for="i_pumpf">Pump condition factor</label><div class="ctl"><input type="number" id="i_pumpf" min="0.5" max="3" step="0.05"></div>
        <span class="hint">1 is the fitted pump cost. The 2022 deployment ran at 1.22.</span></div>
      <div class="f"><label for="i_glide">Glide ratio</label><div class="ctl"><input type="number" id="i_glide" min="0.5" max="6" step="0.1"><span class="unit">: 1</span></div>
        <span class="hint">Horizontal to vertical, through the water. Only affects distance.</span></div>
    </section>

    <section class="panel">
      <h3>Science sensors</h3>
      <label class="toggle"><input type="checkbox" id="i_scicon"> SciCon fitted</label>
      <div id="sci_rows"></div>
      <h4>Sampling (science file)</h4>
      <table class="sci">
        <thead><tr><th>Down to</th><th>Sample every</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody id="bins"></tbody>
      </table>
      <p class="note" id="bins_note"></p>
      <p class="note" id="sci_note"></p>
    </section>

    <section class="panel">
      <h3>Loggers and other payload</h3>
      <div id="log_rows"></div>
    </section>
  </div>

  <div class="bar"><button id="reset" type="button">Reset to defaults</button></div>

  <h2 class="sec">Where the energy goes</h2>
  <div class="charts">

      <figcaption>Energy by load, Ah per day</figcaption>
      <div id="ch_parts"></div>
      <div class="tip" id="tip_parts"></div>
    </figure>
  </div>
</div>

window.SEAGLIDER_MODEL = {"source":"Fitted by code/fit_seaglider_model.py to content/data/seaglider-dives.csv","dives":1553,"glider":{"pump":{"a":12.992320801859373,"b":0.020920925645456195},"motors":{"m0":0.004621157463589271,"m1":0.0008654385128068371},"hotel":{"h0":0.014938559138436669,"h1":0.006386223642142614},"comms":{"c0":0.011546681687738319,"c1":0.0000465393087381684},"tt8":{"per_hour":650.4778640586778,"per_eng":0.7736460227857326,"per_polled":3.0554616643642505,"mA":32.94},"battery":{"capacity":310,"volts":13.28}},"scicon":{"base_mA":6.07,"per_set_mAs":176.7,"fit_missions":[5,6],"hosts":"CT, Contros optode, WET Labs ECO puck (SeaOWL), auxiliary compass"},"sensors":{"SBE_CT":{"label":"CT (Sea-Bird)","mA":24,"s_per_sample":0.672,"measured":true},"CONTOPT":{"label":"Contros HydroFlash O2 optode","mA":300,"s_per_sample":2.816,"measured":true},"ECO":{"label":"WET Labs ECO puck","mA":105,"s_per_sample":2.52,"measured":false}}};
</script>
<script>
/*
 * Seaglider endurance model (firmware 66.12, single battery pack), fitted to our glider's logs.
 *
 * One function, used both by the page (content/seaglider-endurance.qmd, where the build
 * script inlines it) and by code/build_seaglider_page.js, which runs it against every logged
 * dive before the page is rebuilt. Coefficients come from content/data/seaglider-model.json;
 * see code/fit_seaglider_model.py for how each one was fitted.
 *
 * Everything is Ah drawn from the pack per dive cycle (surface + dive).
 */
(function (root) {
  "use strict";

  // Sensors that can be hosted by the SciCon or polled by the TT8. The SciCon fit covers
  // all three sampled together, so a subset on the SciCon is charged that fit's per-sample
  // energy in proportion to the sensors' TT8-equivalent energy per sample. The proportion is
  // an estimate; the total is measured.
  var SCICON_FITTED_SET = ["SBE_CT", "CONTOPT", "ECO"];

  function sampleEnergy(model, key, mA) {
    var s = model.sensors[key];
    return (mA == null ? s.mA : mA) * s.s_per_sample; // mAs per sample
  }

  // Samples in one dive from a science-file style table: rows of {to: depth (m), interval (s)},
  // each row covering from the previous row's depth down to its own. The glider passes through
  // every band twice (down and up) at the mean vertical speed w.
  function samplesPerDive(bins, depth, w) {
    var n = 0, top = 0;
    var rows = (bins || []).filter(function (b) { return b && b.to > 0 && b.interval > 0; })
      .sort(function (a, b) { return a.to - b.to; });
    for (var i = 0; i < rows.length && top < depth; i++) {
      var bottom = Math.min(rows[i].to, depth);
      if (bottom > top) n += 2 * (bottom - top) / w / rows[i].interval;
      top = Math.max(top, rows[i].to);
    }
    if (top < depth && rows.length) n += 2 * (depth - top) / w / rows[rows.length - 1].interval;
    return n;
  }

  function evaluate(model, cfg) {
    var g = model.glider;
    var diveS = 2 * cfg.depth / cfg.w;              // w is the mean vertical speed over the dive
    var diveH = diveS / 3600;
    var cycleH = diveH + cfg.surface_min / 60;
    var callN = Math.max(1, cfg.call_ndives || 1);
    var nSamples = samplesPerDive(cfg.bins, cfg.depth, cfg.w);

    var parts = [];                                  // {key, label, ah per dive}
    function add(key, label, ah) { parts.push({ key: key, label: label, ah: ah }); }

    var pumpJ = (cfg.pump_factor || 1) * (cfg.max_buoy + cfg.sm_cc) * (g.pump.a + g.pump.b * cfg.depth);
    add("pump", "Buoyancy pump", pumpJ / (cfg.battery.volts * 3600));
    add("motors", "Pitch and roll motors", g.motors.m0 + g.motors.m1 * diveH);
    add("hotel", "Processor, compass and sleep", g.hotel.h0 + g.hotel.h1 * cycleH);
    // Iridium: the fixed cost of a call is paid every CALL_NDIVES dives, but the data volume
    // still has to go up, so only the fixed part divides.
    add("comms", "Iridium and GPS", g.comms.c0 / callN + g.comms.c1 * cfg.kb);

    // Science sensors, on the SciCon or polled by the TT8.
    var sci = cfg.science || {};
    var polledS = 0, fitted = 0, chosen = 0;
    SCICON_FITTED_SET.forEach(function (k) { fitted += sampleEnergy(model, k); });
    Object.keys(sci).forEach(function (k) {
      var s = sci[k];
      if (!s || !s.on) return;
      if (cfg.scicon) {
        chosen += sampleEnergy(model, k);
      } else {
        polledS += model.sensors[k].s_per_sample * nSamples;
        add("sci_" + k, model.sensors[k].label, sampleEnergy(model, k, s.mA) * nSamples / 3.6e6);
      }
    });
    if (cfg.scicon && chosen > 0) {
      var sc = model.scicon;
      add("scicon", "SciCon and its sensors",
          (sc.base_mA * diveS + sc.per_set_mAs * (chosen / fitted) * nSamples) / 3.6e6);
    }
    var tt8S = g.tt8.per_hour * cycleH + g.tt8.per_eng * nSamples + g.tt8.per_polled * polledS;
    add("tt8", "TT8 sampling", g.tt8.mA * tt8S / 3.6e6);

    // Loggers: current x time recording. They record above a depth, on a share of dives.
    (cfg.loggers || []).forEach(function (L) {
      if (!L.on) return;
      var above = L.record_above == null ? 1 : Math.min(1, L.record_above / cfg.depth);
      var duty = L.duty == null ? 1 : L.duty;
      add("log_" + L.key, L.label, L.mA * diveS * above * duty / 3.6e6);
    });

    var total = 0;
    parts.forEach(function (p) { total += p.ah; });
    var usable = cfg.battery.capacity * (1 - (cfg.battery.reserve_pct || 0) / 100);
    var dives = usable / total;
    var kmPerDive = 2 * cfg.depth * cfg.glide_ratio / 1000;
    return {
      parts: parts, total: total, samples: nSamples,
      dive_h: diveH, cycle_h: cycleH, t_dive_min: diveS / 60,
      usable_ah: usable, dives: dives, days: dives * cycleH / 24, km: dives * kmPerDive,
      ah_per_day: total * 24 / cycleH, km_per_day: kmPerDive * 24 / cycleH
    };
  }

  var api = { evaluate: evaluate, samplesPerDive: samplesPerDive };
  if (typeof module !== "undefined" && module.exports) module.exports = api;
  else root.SeagliderModel = api;
})(this);
</script>
<!-- SEAGLIDER-DATA:END -->

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var M = window.SEAGLIDER_MODEL, EV = window.SeagliderModel.evaluate;
  var $ = function (id) { return document.getElementById(id); };
  var fmt = function (x, d) { return isFinite(x) ? x.toLocaleString("en", { minimumFractionDigits: d || 0, maximumFractionDigits: d || 0 }) : "–"; };
  var esc = function (s) { return String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, function (c) { return { "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;" }[c]; }); };

  $("n_dives").textContent = M.dives.toLocaleString("en");

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ inputs
  var SCI = ["SBE_CT", "CONTOPT", "ECO"];
  var LOG = [
    { key: "PAM", name: "PAM recorder", mA: 55, above: 200 },
    { key: "UVP", name: "UVP6", mA: 80, above: 1000 },
    { key: "ESNDR", name: "Echosounder", mA: 400, above: 1000 },
    { key: "CUSTOM", name: "Other sensor", mA: 20, above: 1000, custom: true }
  ];
  var NBINS = 4;

  // Where the page opens. Our glider as it now flies: no SciCon, CT and optode on the TT8.
  var DEFAULTS = {
    depth: 1000, w: 0.1, surface_min: 10, max_buoy: 200, sm_cc: 300, kb: 150, call_ndives: 1,
    capacity: M.glider.battery.capacity, reserve: 10, volts: M.glider.battery.volts,
    pump_factor: 1, glide_ratio: 2.5,
    scicon: false, sci: { SBE_CT: true, CONTOPT: true, ECO: false },
    bins: [{ to: 200, interval: 5 }, { to: 1000, interval: 10 }],
    log: { PAM: false, UVP: false, ESNDR: false, CUSTOM: false }
  };

  $("sci_rows").innerHTML = SCI.map(function (k) {
    var s = M.sensors[k];
    return '<div class="sensor"><input type="checkbox" id="c_' + k + '" aria-label="' + esc(s.label) + '">' +
      '<label class="name" for="c_' + k + '">' + esc(s.label) + (s.measured ? "" : '<span class="tag" title="Only ever flew on the SciCon; its cost on the TT8 is estimated">est.</span>') + '</label>' +
      '<span class="ctl"><input type="number" id="m_' + k + '" min="0" step="1" aria-label="' + esc(s.label) + ' current"><span class="unit">mA</span></span>' +
      '<span class="sub">' + s.s_per_sample.toFixed(2) + ' s powered per sample without the SciCon</span></div>';
  }).join("");
  $("log_rows").innerHTML = LOG.map(function (s) {
    return '<div class="sensor"><input type="checkbox" id="c_' + s.key + '" aria-label="' + esc(s.name) + '">' +
      (s.custom ? '<input type="text" id="n_' + s.key + '" value="Other sensor" aria-label="Name of the other sensor">' : '<label class="name" for="c_' + s.key + '">' + esc(s.name) + '</label>') +
      '<span class="ctl"><input type="number" id="m_' + s.key + '" min="0" step="1" aria-label="' + esc(s.name) + ' current"><span class="unit">mA</span></span>' +
      '<span class="sub"><span>records above <input type="number" id="a_' + s.key + '" min="1" step="10" aria-label="' + esc(s.name) + ' records above depth"> m</span>' +
      '<span>on <input type="number" id="d_' + s.key + '" min="0" max="100" step="5" aria-label="' + esc(s.name) + ' share of dives"> % of dives</span></span></div>';
  }).join("");
  var binRows = "";
  for (var i = 0; i < NBINS; i++) {
    binRows += '<tr><td><input type="number" id="bt_' + i + '" min="1" step="10" aria-label="Band ' + (i + 1) + ' down to depth"> m</td>' +
      '<td><input type="number" id="bi_' + i + '" min="1" step="1" aria-label="Band ' + (i + 1) + ' sample interval"> s</td></tr>';
  }
  $("bins").innerHTML = binRows;

  function load(p) {
    $("i_depth").value = p.depth; $("i_w").value = p.w; $("i_surface").value = p.surface_min;
    $("i_maxbuoy").value = p.max_buoy; $("i_smcc").value = p.sm_cc; $("i_kb").value = p.kb;
    $("i_calln").value = p.call_ndives; $("i_cap").value = p.capacity; $("i_reserve").value = p.reserve;
    $("i_volts").value = p.volts; $("i_pumpf").value = p.pump_factor; $("i_glide").value = p.glide_ratio;
    $("i_scicon").checked = p.scicon;
    SCI.forEach(function (k) { $("c_" + k).checked = p.sci[k]; $("m_" + k).value = M.sensors[k].mA; });
    LOG.forEach(function (x) {
      $("c_" + x.key).checked = p.log[x.key]; $("m_" + x.key).value = x.mA; $("a_" + x.key).value = x.above; $("d_" + x.key).value = 100;
    });
    for (var i = 0; i < NBINS; i++) {
      var b = p.bins[i];
      $("bt_" + i).value = b ? b.to : ""; $("bi_" + i).value = b ? b.interval : "";
    }
  }

  var num = function (id) { var v = parseFloat($(id).value); return isFinite(v) ? v : 0; };

  function readConfig(overrides) {
    var science = {};
    SCI.forEach(function (k) { science[k] = { on: $("c_" + k).checked, mA: num("m_" + k) }; });
    var loggers = LOG.map(function (x) {
      return { key: x.key, label: x.custom ? ($("n_" + x.key).value || "Other sensor") : x.name,
               on: $("c_" + x.key).checked, mA: num("m_" + x.key), record_above: num("a_" + x.key) || null,
               duty: num("d_" + x.key) / 100 };
    });
    var bins = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < NBINS; i++) {
      var to = num("bt_" + i), iv = num("bi_" + i);
      if (to > 0 && iv > 0) bins.push({ to: to, interval: iv });
    }
    var cfg = {
      depth: Math.max(1, num("i_depth")), w: Math.max(0.005, num("i_w")),
      surface_min: num("i_surface"), max_buoy: num("i_maxbuoy"), sm_cc: num("i_smcc"), kb: num("i_kb"),
      call_ndives: Math.max(1, Math.round(num("i_calln"))), bins: bins,
      pump_factor: num("i_pumpf") || 1, glide_ratio: num("i_glide"),
      scicon: $("i_scicon").checked, science: science, loggers: loggers,
      battery: { capacity: num("i_cap"), volts: Math.max(1, num("i_volts")), reserve_pct: num("i_reserve") }
    };
    for (var k in overrides || {}) cfg[k] = overrides[k];
    return cfg;
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ charts
  // Charts are drawn at their container's pixel width, so text stays 11px at any size.
  var W = 560, H = 280, PAD = { l: 46, r: 16, t: 12, b: 36 };
  function widthOf(id) { return Math.max(240, Math.round($(id).clientWidth || 560)); }
  function niceMax(v) {
    if (!(v > 0)) return 1;
    var e = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(v))), f = v / e;
    return (f <= 1 ? 1 : f <= 2 ? 2 : f <= 2.5 ? 2.5 : f <= 5 ? 5 : 10) * e;
  }
  function ticks(max, n) { var out = [], step = max / n; for (var i = 0; i <= n; i++) out.push(i * step); return out; }
  function showTip(tip, fig, html, x, y) {
    tip.innerHTML = html; tip.style.display = "block";
    var fw = fig.clientWidth, tw = tip.offsetWidth;
    tip.style.left = Math.max(4, Math.min(fw - tw - 4, x + 12)) + "px";
    tip.style.top = Math.max(4, y - 10) + "px";
  }

  function drawDepth(cfg) {
    var anySci = SCI.some(function (k) { return cfg.science[k].on; });
    W = widthOf("ch_depth"); H = Math.round(Math.min(320, Math.max(240, W * 0.5)));
    var depths = []; for (var d = 50; d <= 1000; d += 25) depths.push(d);
    var series = [
      { name: "With the SciCon", color: "var(--s1)", scicon: true },
      { name: "Without the SciCon", color: "var(--s2)", scicon: false }
    ];
    if (!anySci) series = [{ name: "Endurance", color: "var(--s1)", scicon: cfg.scicon }];
    series.forEach(function (s) {
      s.pts = depths.map(function (d) {
        var r = EV(M, readConfig({ depth: d, scicon: s.scicon }));
        return { d: d, days: r.days, km: r.km };
      });
      s.here = EV(M, readConfig({ scicon: s.scicon })).days;
    });
    var ymax = niceMax(Math.max.apply(null, series.map(function (s) { return Math.max.apply(null, s.pts.map(function (p) { return p.days; })); })));
    var x = function (d) { return PAD.l + (d - 50) / 950 * (W - PAD.l - PAD.r); };
    var y = function (v) { return H - PAD.b - v / ymax * (H - PAD.t - PAD.b); };
    var svg = '<svg viewBox="0 0 ' + W + " " + H + '" role="img" aria-label="Endurance in days against dive depth">';
    ticks(ymax, 4).forEach(function (t) {
      svg += '<line class="grid" x1="' + PAD.l + '" x2="' + (W - PAD.r) + '" y1="' + y(t) + '" y2="' + y(t) + '"/>' +
        '<text x="' + (PAD.l - 6) + '" y="' + (y(t) + 4) + '" text-anchor="end">' + fmt(t, ymax < 10 ? 1 : 0) + "</text>";
    });
    [100, 200, 400, 600, 800, 1000].forEach(function (t) {
      svg += '<text x="' + x(t) + '" y="' + (H - PAD.b + 16) + '" text-anchor="middle">' + t + "</text>";
    });
    svg += '<text x="' + ((W + PAD.l) / 2) + '" y="' + (H - 4) + '" text-anchor="middle">Dive depth (m)</text>';
    svg += '<text x="12" y="' + (PAD.t + 4) + '" transform="rotate(-90 12 ' + (PAD.t + 4) + ')" text-anchor="end">days</text>';
    svg += '<line class="axis" x1="' + PAD.l + '" x2="' + (W - PAD.r) + '" y1="' + y(0) + '" y2="' + y(0) + '"/>';
    var cx = x(Math.min(1000, Math.max(50, cfg.depth)));
    svg += '<line x1="' + cx + '" x2="' + cx + '" y1="' + PAD.t + '" y2="' + y(0) + '" style="stroke:var(--ink-3);stroke-dasharray:3 3"/>';
    series.forEach(function (s) {
      svg += '<path d="' + s.pts.map(function (p, i) { return (i ? "L" : "M") + x(p.d).toFixed(1) + "," + y(p.days).toFixed(1); }).join("") +
        '" fill="none" style="stroke:' + s.color + '" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>';
    });
    series.forEach(function (s) {
      svg += '<circle cx="' + cx + '" cy="' + y(s.here) + '" r="' + (s.scicon === cfg.scicon ? 5 : 4) + '" style="fill:' + s.color + ';stroke:var(--surface);stroke-width:2"/>';
    });
    svg += '<g id="xh" style="display:none"><line class="axis" y1="' + PAD.t + '" y2="' + y(0) + '"/></g>';
    svg += '<rect x="' + PAD.l + '" y="' + PAD.t + '" width="' + (W - PAD.l - PAD.r) + '" height="' + (H - PAD.t - PAD.b) + '" fill="transparent" id="hit_depth"/>';
    svg += "</svg>";
    $("ch_depth").innerHTML = svg;
    $("leg_depth").innerHTML = series.map(function (s) {
      return '<span><i style="background:' + s.color + '"></i>' + esc(s.name) + (series.length > 1 && s.scicon === cfg.scicon ? " (selected)" : "") + "</span>";
    }).join("") + '<span style="color:var(--ink-3)">dashed line: your depth</span>';

    var fig = $("fig_depth"), tip = $("tip_depth"), svgEl = fig.querySelector("svg"), xh = svgEl.querySelector("#xh");
    var hit = svgEl.querySelector("#hit_depth");
    hit.addEventListener("mousemove", function (ev) {
      var r = svgEl.getBoundingClientRect(), sx = (ev.clientX - r.left) / r.width * W;
      var i = Math.max(0, Math.min(depths.length - 1, Math.round((sx - PAD.l) / (W - PAD.l - PAD.r) * (depths.length - 1))));
      var line = xh.querySelector("line"); line.setAttribute("x1", x(depths[i])); line.setAttribute("x2", x(depths[i])); xh.style.display = "";
      var fr = fig.getBoundingClientRect();
      showTip(tip, fig, "<div>" + depths[i] + " m dives</div>" + series.map(function (s) {
        return '<div><i style="display:inline-block;width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;margin-right:5px;background:' + s.color + '"></i>' + esc(s.name) + ": <b>" + fmt(s.pts[i].days, 0) + "</b> days, " + fmt(s.pts[i].km, 0) + " km</div>";
      }).join(""), ev.clientX - fr.left, ev.clientY - fr.top);
    });
    hit.addEventListener("mouseleave", function () { tip.style.display = "none"; xh.style.display = "none"; });
  }

  function drawParts(res) {
    var perDay = 24 / res.cycle_h;
    var rows = res.parts.filter(function (p) { return p.ah > 0; }).map(function (p) { return { label: p.label, v: p.ah * perDay, dive: p.ah }; })
      .sort(function (a, b) { return b.v - a.v; });
    var W2 = widthOf("ch_parts"), rowH = 26, LBL = Math.min(190, W2 * 0.45), H2 = rows.length * rowH + 30;
    var xmax = niceMax(rows.length ? rows[0].v : 1);
    var x = function (v) { return LBL + v / xmax * (W2 - LBL - 60); };
    var svg = '<svg viewBox="0 0 ' + W2 + " " + H2 + '" role="img" aria-label="Energy by load in Ah per day">';
    ticks(xmax, 4).forEach(function (t) {
      svg += '<line class="grid" x1="' + x(t) + '" x2="' + x(t) + '" y1="0" y2="' + (rows.length * rowH) + '"/>' +
        '<text x="' + x(t) + '" y="' + (rows.length * rowH + 16) + '" text-anchor="middle">' + fmt(t, xmax < 2 ? 2 : 1) + "</text>";
    });
    rows.forEach(function (r, i) {
      var y0 = i * rowH + 5, w = Math.max(2, x(r.v) - LBL);
      svg += '<text class="lab" x="' + (LBL - 8) + '" y="' + (y0 + 12) + '" text-anchor="end">' + esc(r.label.length > 30 ? r.label.slice(0, 29) + "…" : r.label) + "</text>" +
        '<rect x="' + LBL + '" y="' + y0 + '" width="' + w + '" height="16" rx="4" style="fill:var(--s1)"/>' +
        '<text class="val" x="' + (LBL + w + 6) + '" y="' + (y0 + 12) + '">' + fmt(r.v, 2) + "</text>" +
        '<rect x="0" y="' + (i * rowH) + '" width="' + W2 + '" height="' + rowH + '" fill="transparent" data-i="' + i + '"/>';
    });
    svg += "</svg>";
    $("ch_parts").innerHTML = svg;
    var fig = $("fig_parts"), tip = $("tip_parts");
    fig.querySelectorAll("rect[data-i]").forEach(function (el) {
      el.addEventListener("mousemove", function (ev) {
        var r = rows[+el.getAttribute("data-i")], fr = fig.getBoundingClientRect();
        showTip(tip, fig, "<div>" + esc(r.label) + "</div><div><b>" + fmt(r.v, 3) + "</b> Ah/day, <b>" + fmt(r.dive, 4) + "</b> Ah/dive</div><div>" +
          fmt(100 * r.dive / res.total, 0) + "% of the load</div>", ev.clientX - fr.left, ev.clientY - fr.top);
      });
      el.addEventListener("mouseleave", function () { tip.style.display = "none"; });
    });
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ update
  function update() {
    var onSci = $("i_scicon").checked;
    SCI.forEach(function (k) { $("m_" + k).disabled = onSci || !$("c_" + k).checked; });
    LOG.forEach(function (x) { ["m_", "a_", "d_"].forEach(function (p) { $(p + x.key).disabled = !$("c_" + x.key).checked; }); });
    $("sci_note").textContent = onSci
      ? "With the SciCon, the sensors cost what the SciCon measured drawing for them (" + M.scicon.base_mA + " mA plus " + M.scicon.per_set_mAs + " mAs per sample of all three), so the mA boxes are not used."
      : "Without the SciCon, the TT8 polls each sensor: it is charged its current for the seconds it is powered per sample, and the TT8 stays awake while it waits.";

    var cfg = readConfig(), res = EV(M, cfg);
    $("o_days").textContent = fmt(res.days, 0);
    $("o_km").textContent = fmt(res.km, 0);
    $("o_dives").textContent = fmt(res.dives, 0);
    $("o_ahday").textContent = fmt(res.ah_per_day, 2);
    $("o_ahdive").textContent = fmt(res.total, 3);
    $("o_cycle").textContent = fmt(res.cycle_h, 2) + " h";
    $("o_usable").textContent = fmt(res.usable_ah, 0);
    $("h_w").textContent = "Including apogee. T_DIVE equivalent " + fmt(res.t_dive_min, 0) + " min.";
    $("bins_note").textContent = cfg.bins.length
      ? "Each band runs from the one above it down to its depth; below the last band, its interval carries on. " + fmt(res.samples, 0) + " samples per dive."
      : "Enter at least one band.";

    var anySci = SCI.some(function (k) { return cfg.science[k].on; });
    if (anySci) {
      var a = EV(M, readConfig({ scicon: true })), b = EV(M, readConfig({ scicon: false }));
      $("compare").innerHTML =
        '<span class="' + (cfg.scicon ? "cur" : "") + '">With the SciCon: <b>' + fmt(a.days, 0) + "</b> days, " + fmt(a.ah_per_day, 2) + " Ah/day</span>" +
        '<span class="' + (!cfg.scicon ? "cur" : "") + '">Without the SciCon: <b>' + fmt(b.days, 0) + "</b> days, " + fmt(b.ah_per_day, 2) + " Ah/day</span>";
    } else {
      $("compare").innerHTML = "<span>No science sensors ticked, so the SciCon makes no difference.</span>";
    }

    var alerts = [];
    if (!cfg.bins.length) alerts.push("No sampling bands entered: the sensors are not being charged.");
    if (cfg.depth > 1000) alerts.push("Deeper than 1000 m: beyond the Seaglider's rating and anything the glider has logged.");
    if (cfg.w < 0.05 || cfg.w > 0.2) alerts.push("Mean vertical speed outside 0.05–0.2 m/s, the range the glider has flown.");
    if (!cfg.scicon && cfg.science.ECO.on) alerts.push("The ECO puck has only flown on the SciCon; its cost without it is estimated.");
    if (!cfg.scicon && cfg.science.CONTOPT.on) alerts.push("Without the SciCon the optode is charged its rated 300 mA while powered, as the glider books it. Its real draw may be lower; edit the mA if it has been measured.");
    var pam = cfg.loggers[0];
    if (pam.on && pam.mA > 0) alerts.push("The PAM is counted here, but the glider's own battery counter leaves it out: expect the glider to report more remaining than there is.");
    $("alerts").innerHTML = alerts.map(function (t) { return '<div class="alert">' + esc(t) + "</div>"; }).join("");

    drawDepth(cfg);
    drawParts(res);
  }

  $("reset").addEventListener("click", function () { load(DEFAULTS); update(); });
  document.querySelectorAll("#sge .panels input").forEach(function (el) {
    el.addEventListener("input", update); el.addEventListener("change", update);
  });
  var rt; window.addEventListener("resize", function () { clearTimeout(rt); rt = setTimeout(update, 150); });

  load(DEFAULTS);
  update();
  // Quarto settles its layout (sidebar, margins) after this script runs, and the charts are
  // drawn at their container's width, so draw once more when the page has finished loading.
  window.addEventListener("load", update);
})();
</script>
```
